description: DTM - Cartografia delle aree esposte a frane di crollo (cartografia raster a maglia 20x20m) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ambiente.regione.emilia-romagna.it. The cartography derived from the use of the viewshed-visibility function on areas of probable triggering of collapses to determine the exposure of the slopes to this phenomenon. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "DTM - Cartography of areas exposed to collapse landslides (knitted raster cartography 20x20m)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in TIFF. The listing shows 2011-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
